connect_wecom_adapter: connect the WeCom adapter to the AI Bot WebSocket gateway with bot credentials
send_markdown_message: send a markdown message to a WeCom chat with optional reply context
send_image_to_chat: send an image to a WeCom chat with an optional caption and reply target
send_document_to_chat: send a document file to a WeCom chat with optional caption and filename
send_voice_to_chat: send an AMR voice file to a WeCom chat with optional caption and reply target
send_video_to_chat: send a video file to a WeCom chat with optional caption and reply target
check_wecom_requirements: check if aiohttp and httpx dependencies are available for WeCom operation
configure_wecom_policy: configure WeCom DM and group access policies with allowlists
batch_merge_text_messages: batch and merge rapid successive text messages split by the WeCom client
cache_inbound_media: cache inbound image and file attachments from WeCom messages to local storage
